column3: MT 3:31. “Languages” is rendered “men of every language,” and “may your peace increase” “May your peace abound!”
MT 3:32. “With me” is rendered “for me.”
MT 3:33. “Strong” is rendered “mighty”; “with generation and generation” is rendered “from generation to generation.”
MT 4:1. Close to the Aramaic.
MT 4:2. “Imaginings” is rendered “these fantasies,” and “visions of my head” “visions in my mind.”
MT 4:3. Close to the Aramaic.
MT 4:4. “Astrologers” is rendered “diviners.”
MT 4:5. “A spirit of holy gods” is rendered “a spirit of the holy gods”; NASB adds “saying.”
MT 4:6. “No secret oppresses you” is rendered “no mystery baffles you”; NASB adds “since” and “along with.”
MT 4:7. “Visions of my head” is rendered “visions in my mind”; NASB adds “these were.”
MT 4:8. “Its sight” is rendered “it was visible,” and “heavens” “sky.”
MT 4:9. “Nested” is rendered “dwelt,” and “all flesh” “all living creatures.”
MT 4:10. “A watcher” is rendered “an angelic watcher.”
MT 4:11. “Proclaiming with power” is rendered “shouted out.”
MT 4:12. “Fetter” is rendered “band”; NASB adds “around it” and “new,” and renders “let it become wet” as “let him be drenched,” with “him” for “it.”
MT 4:13. “Heart” is rendered “mind,” and “seven times” “seven periods of time.”
MT 4:14. “Watchers” is rendered “angelic watchers”; “the kingdom of the human” is rendered “the realm of mankind,” and NASB adds “This sentence.”
MT 4:15. NASB adds “Now” and renders “who” as “for.”
MT 4:16. “About one moment” is rendered “for a while”; “be for your enemy” is rendered “if only the dream applied to those who hate you.”
MT 4:17. “Its sight” is rendered “was visible.”
MT 4:18. The second “dwelt” is rendered “lodged.”
MT 4:19. “Greatness” is rendered “majesty”; NASB adds “for.”
MT 4:20. “A watcher” is rendered “an angelic watcher”; “fetter” is rendered “band,” with “around it” and “new” added, and “seven times” “seven periods of time.”
MT 4:21. Close to the Aramaic.

MT 4:22. The active “they will chase,” “they will feed,” and “they will wet” are rendered as passives; “seven times” is rendered “seven periods of time,” and “kingdom of humankind” “realm of mankind.”
MT 4:23. “They said” is rendered “it was commanded”; “Heavens” is rendered “Heaven,” with “it is … that” added.
MT 4:24. “Right doing” is rendered “doing righteousness”; NASB adds “now,” and renders “whether” as “in case.”
MT 4:25. Close to the Aramaic.
MT 4:26. “On the palace” is rendered “on the roof of the royal palace”; NASB supplies “the roof.”
MT 4:27. “Replying” is rendered “reflected,” and “house of a kingdom” “royal residence.”
